SELECT p.post_id, p.writer_id, p.category_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comment_count,
DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y. %m. %d.') AS created_at_str, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, pc.category_name FROM post p LEFT JOIN members m ON p.writer_id = m.member_id
JOIN post_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id
ORDER BY p.post_id ASC
ORDER BY p.post_id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
